name: @cf-mfe/ui
//exports: Source-only, no build step. Every consumer is a Vite app, so Vite compiles these .tsx files as part of the app that imports them — which also means HMR works across the package boundary and there's no build ordering to get wrong. Swap to a dist/ build only if a non-Vite consumer appears.
//peerDependencies: Peers, not dependencies: MUI, Emotion and React must resolve to the ONE copy the host federates as a singleton. A direct dependency here risks pnpm giving this package its own nested copy, which would break the shared-singleton contract and leave these components reading a different ThemeProvider than the app around them.
